title: Warehouse Team Leader (f/m/d)
description:
Lead a shift team in a consumer-goods warehouse. German is the team language; English at A2 level is enough for system screens.

What you'll do
- Lead 15 colleagues, plan shifts and allocate tasks
- Ensure safety and quality standards
- Report KPIs on service levels and error rates

What you bring
- 3+ years in warehouse operations including team lead experience
- SAP EWM or a similar WMS
- Forklift licence
